metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: ImageMagick: Heap Buffer Over-Write in morphology operation when an invalid kernel is provided
properties.description: ImageMagick: Heap Buffer Over-Write in morphology operation when an invalid kernel is provided
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "imagemagick" or Msg contains "heap" or message_s contains "imagemagick" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), SourceIP | where count_ > 3 // GHADV-0690
